question: In the context of the GST framework, what is the full form of SGST?
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Goods & Service Tax**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **State Goods & Service Tax (SGST)** is a component of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India.
 
• SGST is levied by the state government on intra-state transactions of goods and services.
